The goal of this portfolio piece is to add error bars to a figure and add a caption explaining what significance the asterisks in the figure represent. 


```{r sigbars}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

image2 <- data.frame(
  valence = rep(c("positive", "negative"), 1),
  value = c(0.556051997, 0.168044077), 
  standard_error = c(0.107431103, 0.108079632)
)


ggplot(image2, aes(x=valence, y = value)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  xlab("Valence") + 
  ylab("Image 2 Intensity Rating Difference") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,0.9, by=.1), limits = c(0, 0.9)) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6), 
        text=element_text(family = "Times New Roman"), 
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust=0, size = 10)) + 
  labs(
    title = "Image 2 Valence and Difference in Emotional Intensity Rating", 
    caption = "*** p < .001"
  ) + 
  geom_bracket ( 
    xmin = c("negative"), 
    xmax = c("positive"),
    label = c("***"), 
    y.position = c(0.7) 
    )

```
